vectors.requirement: RFC 8414 discovery and profile capability validation
vectors.operation: GET <issuer>/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

vectors.requirement: Metadata issuer must exactly match the configured issuer
vectors.operation: Validate metadata whose issuer is https://attacker.example

vectors.requirement: Distinct Agent Client Instances do not share an Agent Key
vectors.operation: Register key-a to a second Agent Client Instance at the same issuer

vectors.requirement: PAR accepts matching DPoP proof and dpop_jkt bindings
vectors.operation: POST pushed_authorization_request_endpoint with exact registration values, DPoP key-a, and dpop_jkt key-a

vectors.requirement: The profile does not require an undeclared principal-hint parameter
vectors.operation: POST a valid PAR request without login_hint

vectors.requirement: dpop_jkt is accepted after possession of the registered key was established
vectors.operation: POST PAR with dpop_jkt key-a and no DPoP header after a successful proof-of-possession operation

vectors.requirement: An uploaded public key is not proof of possession
vectors.operation: POST PAR with dpop_jkt key-a before possession was established

vectors.requirement: DPoP proof and dpop_jkt must identify the same registered key
vectors.operation: POST PAR with DPoP key-a and dpop_jkt key-b

vectors.requirement: Redirect URI matching is exact
vectors.operation: POST PAR with <redirect-uri>/extra

vectors.requirement: Exactly one registered resource is allowed
vectors.operation: POST PAR with two resource parameters

vectors.requirement: A consumed PAR request URI is not reusable
vectors.operation: Use the same request_uri in two authorization requests

vectors.requirement: The response issuer and one-time state match the initiating session
vectors.operation: Validate callback with expected iss and unused state

vectors.requirement: RFC 9207 issuer mismatch is terminal
vectors.operation: Validate callback with iss https://attacker.example

vectors.requirement: Security-sensitive authorization-response parameters occur once
vectors.operation: Validate callback containing two state parameters

vectors.requirement: Authorization codes are bound to PKCE S256
vectors.operation: Exchange a valid code using a different code_verifier

vectors.requirement: The token proof key matches the PAR binding and current registered key
vectors.operation: Exchange a key-a-bound code using DPoP key-b

vectors.requirement: RFC 9068 and profile claims do not depend on private short aliases
vectors.operation: Inspect a successfully issued DPoP-bound JWT access token

vectors.requirement: Token endpoint responses are not cached
vectors.operation: Inspect success and error responses from the token endpoint

vectors.requirement: A DPoP-bound token is not a bearer token
vectors.operation: Present a valid DPoP-bound access token with Authorization: Bearer

vectors.requirement: DPoP proof jti replay is detected
vectors.operation: Repeat an otherwise valid protected request with the same DPoP proof

vectors.requirement: The DPoP ath binds the presented access token
vectors.operation: Present token-a with a DPoP proof containing the hash of token-b

vectors.requirement: RFC 8693 attenuation permits an exact scope-set subset for the same resource and sender
vectors.operation: Exchange a two-scope token for one of those exact scopes using the same client, key, and resource

vectors.requirement: Scope comparison is case-sensitive set containment, not string prefix matching
vectors.operation: Exchange scope payments.read.all from a subject containing only payments.read

vectors.requirement: Attenuation cannot change the sole audience
vectors.operation: Exchange a valid subject token for an unregistered different resource

vectors.requirement: Cross-instance actor tokens are outside the core profile
vectors.operation: Submit actor_token or actor_token_type

vectors.requirement: A successful refresh atomically replaces the refresh token
vectors.operation: Refresh a current key-a-bound family member

vectors.requirement: Reuse revokes the active refresh family
vectors.operation: Use the parent refresh token after a successful rotation

vectors.requirement: Future refresh with a retired Agent Key is rejected
vectors.operation: Rotate registration from key-a to key-b, then refresh using key-a

vectors.requirement: Structured authorization constraints are not lost during refresh or attenuation
vectors.operation: Authorize with typed authorization_details, then refresh and attenuate

vectors.requirement: Revoking a refresh token invalidates its family
vectors.operation: Revoke a current refresh token, then attempt refresh
